newsitem.title: USA: Southern Natl sets holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Southern Natl sets holder rights plan.

text.p: Southern National Corp said its board had adopted a "Rights Plan" for stockholders.

Rights will become exercisable if a person or group acquires 20 percent or more of the company's common stock, or if the board determines that any person or group that has acquired 10 percent or more of Southern National's common is an "Adverse Person," the company said.

The rights plan is intended to deter coercive or unfair takeover tactics and to prevent an acquirer from gaining control of Southern National without offering fair and equal treatment to all stockholders, it said.
